name: LaTeX (via TinyTeX)
description: User-managed LaTeX environment with academic packages, Chinese and Japanese support, formatting, linting, and highlighting.

profile.description: Package tier: TinyTeX-1, TinyTeX plus academic essentials, or TinyTeX-2 (full TeX Live).

languages.description: Additional languages, comma-separated: zh, ja, both, or none.

packages.description: Additional TeX Live package names separated by spaces or commas.

ctanMirror.description: HTTPS TeX Live repository URL without credentials; empty uses automatic CTAN routing.
